# Vacancy research: 863 27th St, Oakland

- **APN:** 003 000502702 (also identified in public listing records as 3-5-27-2)
- **Verdict:** likely_vacant (vacant land)
- **Confidence:** 0.90
- **Vacancy start/duration:** Unknown. Public listing history supports that the parcel was marketed as vacant/raw land by March 2017, but this is not a verified vacancy start date.

## Evidence

1. [Zillow property page](https://www.zillow.com/homedetails/863-27th-St-Oakland-CA-94607/2099021915_zpid/) identifies the parcel as VacantLand and describes it as a vacant lot. It shows listing history reaching March 2017. This supports land use/status, not the date the parcel became vacant.
2. [Compass property page](https://www.compass.com/homedetails/863-27th-St-Oakland-CA-94607/1Q1H6N_pid/) describes the development status as Raw Land and reports no utilities on site. Its recorded active listings include 2023 and 2025.
3. [SVN commercial brochure](https://images1.showcase.com/d2/RsUXeS9CMCKswhREQxNDvVmY2ZTm6xybqjDDXFfQWJA/document.pdf) offers 863 27th Street as a 5,000-square-foot development lot.

## Limits

The available evidence concerns a vacant parcel, not a residence. It cannot establish a residential vacancy period or the date the parcel became vacant. No direct utility, municipal vacancy-tax, permit, or dated street-view evidence was found in this research.
